name: Ready, Set, Parody!
source:
Nothing says fun like P-A-R-O-D-Y.

Have you ever wanted to participate in a game show? Now you can. Have you ever wanted to play Mad Libs or a round of Angry Birds? Now you can!

In Ready, Set, Parody!, the world of hilarity is right at your fingertips. Full of fun costumes and craziness, you never know just what to expect. Your hosts, the cast of X Playing Pieces, can't wait to show you a good time.

HIGHLIGHTS:

*Snarkiness
*Flirting fun
*Cosplay extravaganza
*2 short stories with insane plot twists
*References to video games, visual novels, movies, anime, and more!

What are you waiting for? Come join the fun!

[From [url=https://dreamgazer.itch.io/ready-set-parody]official website[/url]]
translation:
没有什么比P-A-R-O-D-Y更有趣了。

你是否曾想参加游戏节目？现在就能实现。你是否曾想玩填词游戏或来一局《愤怒的小鸟》？现在也能实现！

在《Ready, Set, Parody!》中，欢乐世界就在你的指尖。这里有有趣的服装和疯狂的情节，你永远不知道下一秒会发生什么。X Playing Pieces剧组的主持人们迫不及待想带给你一段快乐时光。

亮点：

*刻薄吐槽
*暧昧调情
*盛大角色扮演
*两篇拥有疯狂反转的短篇故事
*涉及电子游戏、视觉小说、电影、动画等作品的致敬！

还在等什么？快来一起玩吧！

[来源：[url=https://dreamgazer.itch.io/ready-set-parody]官方网站[/url]]
